summary: The Spark Community Sync notes for 11 November 2026 list merged work, including Iceberg field IDs exposed as DSv2 column IDs in Spark 4.2, geometry bounds in Parquet writers, iterative runtime filtering with PartitionPredicate, and a fix to CBO column statistics. Five discussion points are framed as decisions to make, with no outcomes recorded: a freeze date and branch for 1.13; whether to cut 1.12.1 for two silent-data-loss fixes; what gates publishing Spark 4.2 support; whether to skip, add or certify against Spark 4.3; and owners for a set of wrong-result bugs. A list of review requests closes the notes.

topics.title: Highlights: recently merged
topics.summary: Merged for DSv2: Iceberg field IDs set as Spark column IDs so that Spark 4.2 column-ID validation works for nested fields, a parser forwarding fix so CREATE FUNCTION with parameters works with the Iceberg SQL extensions (backported to 4.0 and 4.1), and rethrowing ValidationException from REST 400 responses. Writers now emit geometry bounds in Parquet, and writing variant to ORC fails with a clear error. Reads gained iterative runtime filtering with PartitionPredicate, a fix for unprojected shredded variants in vectorized reads, and scan-schema based CBO column statistics. A per-task scanDuration metric landed for 4.1 with a 4.2 port open.

topics.title: 1.13 release
topics.summary: There is no release candidate or 1.13.x branch yet, and the Spark 4.2 tracker is now on the milestone. The notes ask for a decision on a freeze date and on cutting a branch at RC. No outcome is recorded.
open_questions: What is the 1.13 freeze date, and is a branch cut at RC?

topics.title: A 1.12.1 release?
topics.summary: Two silent-data-loss fixes, for concurrent runtime filtering in copy-on-write UPDATE and for stream-from-timestamp on stream resume, are in no release. The notes ask whether to do a 1.12.1 now or ship them in 1.13. No outcome is recorded.
open_questions: Release 1.12.1 now for the two silent-data-loss fixes, or ship them in 1.13?

topics.title: Spark 4.2 pending items
topics.summary: From the Spark 4.2 tracker, CREATE TABLE LIKE, schema evolution, partition pruning and cache invalidation tests are merged. The DSv2 Transaction API pull request has no reviews and closes around 14 November. The notes ask what gates publishing 4.2 and who owns each missing piece.
open_questions: What gates publishing Spark 4.2 support, and who owns each missing piece?

topics.title: Spark 4.3: skip, add, or certify 4.2 on it
topics.summary: The question is whether to skip Spark 4.3, add it, or certify the 4.2 module on it. The pull request adding 4.3 is a 661-file copy. The note's author proposed waiting for 4.4. No outcome is recorded.
open_questions: Skip Spark 4.3, add it, or certify 4.2 on it?

topics.title: Wrong-result bugs need reviewers
topics.summary: A set of correctness bugs needs reviewers: scans with different filters sharing an exchange, a metadata DELETE removing NULL rows, WAP with deletion vectors, equality-delete keys, and ExpireSnapshots inside a transaction. The ask is an owner for each and a call on which ones block 1.13.
open_questions: Who owns each wrong-result bug, and which ones block 1.13?

topics.title: Review requests
topics.summary: Reviews were requested for SupportsReportOrdering, the k-way merge rewrite strategy, selective shredded variant extraction readers, applying ReadBuilder.set() properties to Parquet read options (related to the 1.11 OOM issue), wiring InputFilesDecryptor into Spark 4.2 readers, the partial commit failure count fix, using the catalog's Hadoop configuration when listing orphan files, converting TIMESTAMP_MILLIS statistics to micros, carrying custom snapshot properties through replace commits, and aggregate pushdown for identity partition GROUP BY, as well as the shared exchange and NULL-semantics fixes.
